newsitem.title: USA: ArgentBank, Assumption holders ok merger.
newsitem.headline: ArgentBank, Assumption holders ok merger.

text.p: Assumption Bancshares Inc, its subsidiary, Assumption Bank & Trust Co and ArgentBank said Thursday that their shareholders have approved the merger of Assumption Bank with ArgentBank.

The special shareholders' meetings were held after both banks definitively agreed for a merger of Assumption Bank with ArgentBank for $21.5 million, or about $134 per share, in cash and ArgentBank common stock.
The companies said they expect the merger will be consummated in June 1997 pending federal regulatory approval.
Assumption Bank, founded in 1933 and headquartered in Napoleonville, Louisiana, has assets of about $108 million.
ArgentBank is headquartered in Thibodaux, Louisiana, and has assets of about $617 million.
